text: {"summary":"Ratan Tata said at the Tata Chemicals shareholders' meeting, called to remove Nusli Wadia from the board, that he feels lonely and pained by largely unsubstantiated press attacks amid his feud with Cyrus Mistry. He thanked shareholders for their overwhelming support and said the truth will prevail."}

{"summary":"The author, a heavy phone user, praises the Samsung Galaxy S7 as the best phone he's used but switched to a bulkier iPhone 6s Plus because the S7's battery died by 5 p.m. daily. The iPhone's better hardware-software optimization gives longer battery life despite a smaller battery."}

{"summary":"About 40 of over 7,000 attendees at a Tony Robbins seminar in Dallas were burned during a firewalking exercise, echoing a 2012 San Jose incident. The article says firewalking is safe if done correctly, since physics matters, and suggests those burned lingered on the coals, perhaps to take selfies."}

{"summary":"The article rounds up 12 acclaimed 2016 films available for home streaming, 11 on Netflix and one on Hulu. Picks span Disney hits like \"The Jungle Book\" and \"Zootopia,\" the thriller \"The Invitation,\" documentaries such as \"13th,\" the Obama biopic \"Barry,\" and Tina Fey's \"Whiskey Tango Foxtrot.\""}

{"summary":"Designer Charlotte Ronson showed her New York City home on Domaine Home, a comfortable, relatable space with white walls, eclectic art, bright furniture like baby blue dining chairs, and fresh flowers. She says surrounding herself with art and beautiful things makes a real difference."}

{"summary": "Marine biologists worry Finding Dory could spur demand for blue tang fish as pets, as Finding Nemo did for clownfish. Unlike clownfish, blue tangs fare poorly in tanks and can't be bred easily, and lax collection rules in Indonesia and the Philippines could harm ecosystems."}

{"summary":"CBS canceled the sitcom \"We Are Men\" after weak ratings, with premiere viewership of 6.4 million falling to 5.4 million in its second episode. \"2 Broke Girls\" moves to 8:30 p.m. on Oct. 14, and \"Mike and Molly\" returns Nov. 4 at 9 p.m., with \"Big Bang Theory\" repeats airing until then."}

{"summary":"For the fifth year, HuffPost curated 29 standout 2016 online pieces by women, covering Hillary Clinton's campaign, Donald Trump's election, race, sexual assault, and culture. Written by authors like Roxane Gay, Rebecca Traister and Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie, the list stresses that quality journalism by women matters more than ever."}
{"summary": "The U.S. food industry has announced plans to simplify confusing food labels with clearer, easier-to-understand language, which will soon begin appearing on products in grocery stores."}

{"summary":"After releasing his long-awaited sophomore album, ScHoolboy Q revealed he nearly quit rap after Oxymoron because touring kept him away from his seven-year-old daughter for roughly three years. He said he won't put his career over his family, leaving fans wondering how long he'll stay in the game."}

{"summary":"A BuzzFeed-style listicle rounds up 19 teens who stood out in 2016 for funny, extra, or unlucky moments, including a Mulan-themed school ID, a teen who asked himself to homecoming, a boy befriending a deer, and a girl who found a body while playing Pokemon Go."}

{"summary":"Cinematographer Dean Cundey reveals in a new commentary for Scream Factory's upcoming 2K Blu-ray (October 11) that John Carpenter's The Thing used a subtle \"eye light,\" a gleam in actors' eyes, to signal who is still human. Viewers can use it to judge the ending's last survivors."}

{"summary":"Amy Cazin, a former stay-at-home mom, turned down Wal-Mart's offer to carry her natural deodorant brand Primal Pit Paste because she wasn't ready to scale. She had started it with $100 in 2012; sales have doubled yearly, and the products are now sold at Whole Foods and online."}

{"summary":"The Commerce Commission's 2016 Consumer Issues Paper named Spark (140 complaints), Vodafone (133) and Trade Me sellers (121) as the most complained about companies, with price the top issue. Both telcos expressed disappointment, while the Commission stressed complaints don't necessarily mean laws were broken."}

{"summary":"Men are reportedly using period-tracking apps like iAmAMan and uPMS to monitor female colleagues' and partners' cycles so they can avoid them during PMS. One woman said coworkers began tracking her after an argument, and a male colleague complained women can blame moods on periods; the idea drew public dismay on Twitter."}

{"summary":"Brothers Bret and Zach Winingar found an emaciated, locked-in dog in a chewed-up crate while biking in Little Rock, Arkansas. They rescued and named her Charlie Bravo (C.B.), nursed her back to health, and adopted her; donations after her story went viral are funding a new charity, C.B.'s Angels."}

{"summary":"After an Arkansas man's Roomba spread his dog's poop throughout his house, the author argues that smart-home gadgets like Roomba and Nest remain niche because they demand much from users while adding little value. Chaotic home environments make useful, reliable household robots surprisingly hard to build."}

{"summary":"McLaren CEO Mike Flewitt says the company will invest £1 billion ($1.45 billion) over six years to launch 15 new cars by 2022, including a P1 successor and hybrid and electric models. The company aims to raise annual sales from about 2,000 to 5,000 while meeting tighter fuel restrictions and challenging Ferrari."}

{"summary": "Amateur archaeologists from Underground Rome found a previously unknown tunnel under Emperor Hadrian's Villa in Tivoli, Italy, linking the Academy area to the 2.5-mile Grande Trapezio roadway. The tunnels let slaves and merchants keep the estate running unseen, and the new passage appears on no ancient plans."}

{"summary":"Wellness experts from Well + Good say bone broth, a slow-cooked soup made from high-quality bones, vegetables and apple cider vinegar, offers benefits like calcium, collagen and relief for digestive, skin and immunity issues, and works as a filling breakfast drink. The article includes a recipe that simmers for at least eight hours."}

{"summary":"This satirical piece mocks supposed GTA VI leaks, joking about obvious features like main characters, better physics, unstable servers, and microtransaction-heavy DLC. It is explicitly labeled fiction in a weekly satire column, not real news about Rockstar's plans."}

{"summary":"Whole Foods co-CEO Walter Robb says he won't hire people who lack humility and over-promote themselves, a view shared by Google, which wants candidates with both big and small egos. Experts advise crediting coworkers and stressing the value you offer, though Oracle's Larry Ellison once favored self-assured candidates."}

{"summary":"The article says NBC's long-running hit 'The Biggest Loser' appeared to transform contestants' lives, but its extreme regimen of up to eight hours of daily training produced dramatic weight loss that seems to have been only a temporary fix."}

{"summary": "Ceiling fans in India typically have three blades while those in the US have four because of how they are used. Indian fans work alone, spinning faster and efficiently to cool, whereas US fans run slower to circulate air alongside air conditioners, moving larger masses of air."}

{"summary":"The article rounds up 20 smartphone apps that encourage outdoor activity, covering forest and hill trails, stargazing, geocaching, camping, fishing, skateparks, dog-friendly beaches, and family outings. Examples include ViewRanger, Star Walk 2, Strava, The Gruffalo Spotter and Ingress."}

{"summary":"Jessica Simpson, 33, wore an all-black outfit with skinny jeans and stilettos to a family dinner in Calabasas with fiance Eric Johnson and daughter Maxwell, three months after giving birth to son Ace. She says she feels done having kids and tweeted that she needs to make music."}

{"summary": "Harvard psychiatrist Robert Waldinger, who leads the 75-year-long Grant Study of male participants' lives, says its clear finding is that close, intimate, stable relationships, not wealth, fame or career success, make people happier and healthier. He urges people to invest effort in nurturing real connections."}

{"summary":"In 2015, Leann and her husband surprised her Grandpa Ried with an ultrasound photo, and he wept at the news of a great-grandchild before realizing it showed twins. His emotional, expletive-laced reaction was captured on video; Leann gave birth to twin girls in February 2016."}

{"summary":"As Tesla prepares to start Model 3 production in July, the article rounds up lesser-known facts about its cars, including Musk's Easter eggs (Rainbow Road, James Bond submarine mode, Mars), the S3XY naming plan, future semitruck and bus plans, and Model S records like a broken roof-crush machine, Motor Trend Car of the Year, and 315-mile range."}

{"summary":"EA announced the Battlefield 1 Open Beta will end Thursday, September 8, and released a patch removing time limits in Sinai Desert Conquest so matches run until a team hits 250 points. The beta will also simulate extreme launch conditions that may cause server downtime, ahead of the October 21 launch."}

{"summary":"With the U.S. arms embargo on Vietnam ending, the article looks at the biggest buyers of American weapons: Saudi Arabia and the UAE lead, with the Middle East taking about 40% of U.S. exports. It also covers U.S. military financing, Asian and African demand, and growing competition from China."}

{"summary":"Nine-year-old Molly Sings moved the judges, and several to tears, with a blind audition of Kasey Chambers' song asking 'Am I not pretty enough?' on The Voice Kids Australia. Her proud family watched backstage, and Mel B. pitched herself as Molly's best coach, praising her confidence and 'girl power.'"}

{"summary":"Though Sen. Elizabeth Warren insists she isn't running for president, her memoir \"A Fighting Chance\" shows a pattern of initially refusing roles, then accepting them to help people, and is filled with fight-oriented rhetoric. The article argues this makes a compelling implicit case for a White House run."}

{"summary": "On \"Jimmy Kimmel Live,\" Bill Maher urged TV hosts interviewing President-elect Donald Trump to treat him as a politician, hold his feet to the fire, and not let him use them, a nod to criticism of Jimmy Fallon's softball interview. Maher said he'd still welcome Trump on \"Real Time.\""}

{"summary": "BBC commentator Peter Alliss was caught on a hot mic during Sergio Garcia's Masters win saying Garcia's fiancée wore \"the shortest skirt in the country\" and joking about the couple's night. The BBC said the remark was inappropriate; the 86-year-old has a history of controversial comments about women."}

{"summary":"LendLease sold all 391 apartments in the final stage of its Darling Square project in Sydney within four hours, showing strong inner-city demand as investor lending rebounds and rates fall. This is despite an expected glut, with 34,300 new apartments due in the next year and 81,696 over 24 months."}

{"summary":"Lindsay Lohan posted an Instagram photo of herself in a recording studio with her sister Ali Lohan and Duran Duran members Simon le Bon and Nick Rhodes. The post follows the end of her probation for a 2011 necklace theft and a Mean Girls 10th anniversary reunion."}

{"summary":"The article predicts the 9-5 workday will largely disappear within 15 years as millennials push flexible schedules. It cites work-family balance, continuing education, costly offices and remote work, and productivity gains such as 13% in a Chinese firm study, arguing that growing evidence will build manager trust."}

{"summary":"Research by Yonat Zwebner and colleagues at Hebrew University, IDC Herzliya and HEC Paris suggests people come to look like their names. In experiments, volunteers shown a headshot and four or five possible names picked the correct one at a rate significantly higher than chance."}

{"summary":"As the 2014-15 Knicks (5-36) sink toward historic futility, the article ranks the ten worst New York sports seasons, including the 1962 Mets, 1966 Giants, 1996 Jets and 2009-10 Nets. It puts Columbia's 44-game football losing streak from 1983-88 at No. 1, with the Knicks second."}

{"summary": "The tiny plastic tripod in pizza boxes, called a pizza saver, keeps the sagging cardboard lid from sticking to the cheese. Long Island woman Carmela Vitale invented it in 1983 and patented it in 1985, but she let the patent lapse in 1993 and never manufactured it herself."}

{"summary":"After a study showed ex-\"Biggest Loser\" contestants regained weight because their slowed metabolisms burn fewer calories, host Bob Harper suggested intermittent fasting, such as skipping breakfast, might help maintain weight loss. An expert says short-term studies are promising but there is no evidence yet that it works long term."}

{"summary":"Drake's \"Views\" topped the Billboard 200 for a ninth straight week, the longest streak since Adele's \"21\" in 2012 and the first such run driven largely by streaming, with about 77% of its 110,000 equivalent sales coming from streams. A tenth week would tie \"21\"."}

{"summary":"Glee star Alex Newell, who plays transgender character Unique, has joined the cast of Geography Club, an adaptation of Brent Hartinger's novel, alongside Scott Bakula, Ana Gasteyer and Nikki Blonsky. Newell said the script appealed to him because it could open people's eyes to what LGBT youth go through."}

{"summary":"The article compiles anonymous claims from former fast food and concession workers about items to avoid, including McDonald's McCafe drinks and nuggets, KFC BBQ sandwiches, Wendy's chili, Taco Bell beans, ballpark hot dogs, and movie theater popcorn. The claims are unverified anecdotes about reheated, stale or poorly maintained food and equipment."}

{"summary":"A 1964 photo shared by Retronaut shows director Alfred Hitchcock wearing a Beatles-style mop-top wig, in an apparent nod to Beatlemania. The writer doesn't know why it was taken, jokes that he resembles Moe Howard of the Three Stooges, and names it photo of the day."}

{"summary":"A Jezebel tipster noticed that Galbani's full-fat string cheeses feature male cartoon cheese characters, while the low-fat version features a female one. The tipster's 5-year-old daughter pointed it out, and the Galbani website shows the same pattern, which the piece calls oddly sexist."}

{"summary":"Bill Carter, who has covered the TV industry for The New York Times for over 25 years, is taking a voluntary buyout as the paper seeks 100 departures, calling the choice agonizing but driven by economic pressure. He is seeking a new job and has a contract for another late-night TV book."}

{"summary": "After two Irula tribesmen were flown to Florida to catch invasive pythons, Bangalore Mirror trekked through forests near Denkanikottai to find South India's last rat catcher, Eranna, about 60. He learned the craft from his father and says it will die with him, since he won't teach it and his children work in Bengaluru."}

{"summary":"The author argues that the social media posts from mothers promoting multi-level marketing businesses are legitimate opportunities, not illegal pyramid schemes. She says these ventures give struggling families income and flexibility, and urges readers to support these small business owners and keep an open mind."}

{"summary":"Documents obtained by The Guardian show Google registered Google Auto LLC in 2011 to legally operate its self-driving car project, listing it as manufacturer of its 23 Lexus SUVs. The subsidiary likely shields Google from liability, though Google says it will seek established automakers as manufacturing partners."}

{"summary":"A tribal couple from Gujarat's Dahod district, Ramsinh (44) and Kanu Sangot (40), opted for a tubectomy after having 17 children, 16 daughters and one son, following persuasion from villagers. Ramsinh said they kept having children in hopes of another son, while living in poverty as farm labourers."}

{"summary":"Although U.S. guidelines still call fasting before a cholesterol test \"preferred,\" studies show it makes little difference to LDL, HDL and total cholesterol results, with only slight effects on triglycerides. Many European countries no longer require fasting, and doctors say dropping it makes testing easier and more likely to happen."}

{"summary": "As alternatives to the Big Mac index, Bloomberg compared prices of lattes, pizza, Hooters chicken wings and Nobu's black cod across major cities to gauge currency valuations. The results vary widely, showing the dollar overvalued against the yen and pound in lattes, while London looks pricey and Frankfurt cheap for pizza."}

{"summary":"At its Comic-Con panel after season four ended, Orphan Black had actors ad-lib scenes in character, and BBC America released a blooper reel. One clip shows Tatiana Maslany, as Cosima, telling someone on the phone they need to talk to Cosima, a mix-up likely common when she plays multiple clones."}

{"summary": "Three baby genets in South Africa were orphaned after children threw rocks at their mother, and were rescued by the Daktari Bush School and Wildlife Orphanage. A poodle-cocker spaniel mix named Candy nursed them, even producing milk, and two were later released into the wild while Chouchou stayed behind."}

{"summary":"GrubHub's analysis of over 350 campuses found Syracuse University students order the most late-night food, with 1 in 4 orders placed between 10 p.m. and 2 a.m. Overall, students are 87 percent more likely than average diners to order late at night, less likely to order healthy meals, and spend 10 percent less."}

{"summary":"California-based Turing Robotic Industries has unveiled the concept for its Turing Phone Cadenza, a \"superphone\" running its own Swordfish OS with AI features. It claims 12GB RAM, 1TB storage, a 60MP rear camera, four SIM slots and a hydrogen fuel cell battery, with release expected next year."}

{"summary": "A 1995 Mike Tyson fight video appears to show a time traveler with a cameraphone, but it's really one of many handheld cameras then available, per Snopes. The article says such misperceptions, like a 1922 \"wireless phone\" that was a radio, come from modern biases shaping how we view old footage."}

{"summary": "Michigan mom Dayna Mager, whose baby Luella was born in 2015, goes to her every time she cries, even sleeping in the crib with her. A photo her husband took went viral after a missionary's story about silent, sleep-trained babies in a Ugandan orphanage inspired her approach."}

{"summary":"M&M's is launching M&M's Mega in May 2014, a larger version of the candy with three times the chocolate of regular M&M's, available in milk chocolate and peanut varieties. Small bags will cost $1.49 and medium bags $3.29, a response to focus groups requesting bigger candies."}

{"summary":"Nintendo confirmed its $60 NES Classic Edition, launching in November with 30 built-in games, cannot connect to the internet or external storage, so no additional games can ever be added. The standalone console targets casual, nostalgic players rather than hardcore gamers, though demand is expected to be high."}

{"summary":"Written for people who'll never stick to gym resolutions, the article offers ten low-effort ways to stay healthy in 2017, including drinking less juice, improving posture, breathing properly, gardening, stretching for ten minutes, taking walks, drinking warm water, and cutting back on anxiety-inducing Twitter use."}

{"summary":"A Lovehoney survey of 4,400 customers found sex lasts 19 minutes on average, including ten minutes of foreplay. About half were satisfied, while 19% of women and 23% of men wanted longer; couples have quickies 21% of the time, though respondents may be more sexually adventurous than average."}

{"summary":"Pouring milk into Coca-Cola makes the milk curdle into sediment within an hour, which the article attributes to the soda's phosphoric acid. It links this reaction to research suggesting phosphoric acid in colas may lower bone density, though more study is needed and extra calcium is advised."}

{"summary":"On Conan, \"Newsroom\" star Alison Pill explained that last September she accidentally tweeted a topless selfie because she didn't realize her new BlackBerry had a touch screen. She called the mistake dumb and hideously embarrassing, saying it made her self-conscious for months."}

{"summary": "The USDA approved four Chinese poultry processors to export cooked meat from U.S.-raised birds to the U.S., without origin labeling or on-site USDA supervision. Critics, citing China's food safety record, fear this is a first step toward allowing Chinese-raised chicken to be exported to the U.S."}

{"summary":"At Wasatch High School in Heber City, Utah, someone set fire to student Ben Schofield's American flag on his truck, and classmates put it out. Dozens of students then rallied in patriotic gear at a Wal-Mart, and Ben flew a flag again the next day while police investigated."}

{"summary":"An Argentine farmer named Jose found a two-ton fossil buried on his property in Carlos Spegazzini, near Buenos Aires, on Christmas Day. A paleontologist identified it as the shell of a glyptodon, an armored armadillo relative from the Pleistocene that is at least 10,000 years old."}

{"summary":"Labrador retrievers remained America's most popular purebred dog for a record 26th straight year, per the American Kennel Club's 2016 rankings. Rottweilers rose to No. 8, their highest ranking in almost 20 years, while French bulldogs, Siberian huskies and Belgian Malinois also climbed."}

{"summary": "Anthony surprised his 17-year-old sister Anelle by wearing a cap and gown to her graduation, sitting in the family's prominent box seats. Anelle, the class secretary, struggled to hold in her laughter onstage, as classmates recognized the popular alum and others assumed he was a graduate barred from walking."}

{"summary":"A man identified as Michel Bechard was taken into custody on Friday after stripping naked in front of a White House security gate. The Secret Service said he also assaulted a uniformed division officer who tried to subdue him."}

{"summary":"A viral Twitter theory from @strnks proposes that 'Friends' should have ended with Phoebe, a meth-addicted outsider at Central Perk, imagining all 10 seasons while watching the other five real friends. Based on her troubled past references, the dark idea has drawn coverage from Time and the Daily Mail."}

{"summary":"The article claims bay leaves, preferably dried and crushed, can naturally repel cockroaches because the insects hate their smell, which masks the droppings-based scent trails that lead roaches to food and water. It advises placing them in corners, kitchens and gardens, and notes infestations aren't necessarily a sign of poor hygiene."}

{"summary":"Madden NFL 16's annual Super Bowl simulation predicts the Carolina Panthers will beat the Denver Broncos 24-20 in Super Bowl 50, with Cam Newton as MVP. The game has correctly picked the winner nine of 12 times, though it missed the Seahawks' blowout of the Broncos."}

{"summary": "The FBI has detained a man believed to have sprayed a mix of hand cleaner, water, and Tomcat mouse poison on salad bars and produce at a Whole Foods in Ann Arbor, Michigan, and at stores in Flint. No illnesses were reported, his motive is unknown, and he could face felony charges."}

{"summary": "Mary Lou Bruner, a Texas State Board of Education candidate known for conspiracy-laden Facebook posts about Obama, dinosaurs on Noah's ark and the Boy Scouts, lost by a wide margin to chiropractor and school board president Kevin Ellis. She has since made her Facebook private."}

{"summary":"Researchers report that Tamu Massif, an extinct volcano about 400 miles wide beneath the northwest Pacific, is Earth's largest, dwarfing Mauna Loa and nearly matching Olympus Mons on Mars. Once thought part of the Shatsky Rise plateau, it may help refine models of how oceanic plateaus form."}

{"summary":"A supermoon, the year's largest, will turn full at 2:10 p.m. EDT on Aug. 10, 2014, coinciding with the moon's closest approach to Earth, making it up to 14 percent closer and 30 percent brighter than other full moons. It may pair with the Perseid meteor shower; the next supermoon is Sept. 9."}

{"summary":"Scientists say a cat's purr means more than happiness: it may signal anxiety, hunger, appeasement, or self-healing, since its 25-150 Hz frequency matches the range that promotes bone and muscle repair. Some vets think it has little meaning, so its purpose remains uncertain."}

{"summary":"Longtime Simpsons writer John Swartzwelder has joined Twitter, where he mostly posts dry one-liners from his own novels with links to buy them rather than new jokes. The article argues this blunt self-promotion may itself be a clever form of his deadpan humor, like performance art."}

{"summary":"Former \"Real Housewives of Beverly Hills\" star Adrienne Maloof and plastic surgeon Paul Nassif announced they have settled all outstanding divorce issues and pending litigation. In a joint statement, they said they will co-parent their three children and move forward positively after filing for divorce in August 2012."}

{"summary":"Speedrunner BubblesDelFuego holds the Fallout 4 world record of just over an hour, using glitches like quick reload, item climbing, Power Armor clipping and cover slides to skip most of the game. He and fellow runners found the exploits, many carried over from older Bethesda games, and expect to reach 45-55 minutes."}

{"summary":"Over nine months of press for \"Divergent,\" Shailene Woodley has repeatedly used the word \"badass\" in interviews. She applies it to her character Tris, co-star Theo James, author Veronica Roth, her stunt double, and even Sandra Bullock in \"Gravity.\""}

{"summary":"While Drake and Ed Sheeran dominated March's charts and airwaves, this roundup spotlights ten overlooked pop songs from the month. The picks span The Drums, Offaiah, Computer Games, Nelly Furtado, Amine, Maddie Ross, B.O.Y., Louis the Child, Steps and TYSM, covering indie, dance, rap, and pop-rock."}

{"summary": "Former long-haul trucker turned fitness instructor Siphiwe Baleka says chronic sleep deprivation disrupts hormones that regulate hunger and metabolism, causing weight gain. He recommends sleep trackers, a consistent bedtime, turning off electronics an hour before bed, keeping devices out of the bedroom, and calming habits like chamomile tea and reading."}

{"summary":"The small cylinder on a laptop charger cord is a ferrite bead, which filters high-frequency electromagnetic interference. Because the cable can act like an antenna, broadcasting or picking up radio noise, the iron-oxide-based bead blocks those signals so they don't disrupt WiFi, speakers, or other electronics."}

{"summary":"Shrinking Arctic sea ice is making it harder for polar bears to hunt seals, and desperate adult males are increasingly killing and eating younger bears. A National Geographic video captured an adult male chasing down and preying on a mother's cub, illustrating climate change's toll on Arctic wildlife."}

{"summary":"Tesla's \"Part Deux\" master plan, released by Elon Musk, outlines the company's next ten years: expanding into compact SUVs, pickup trucks, heavy-duty semis and urban transports, while overhauling production to boost speed and volume. It frames these goals as part of a push toward sustainable energy."}

{"summary":"A preliminary JAMA Internal Medicine study of nearly 26,000 men found Viagra users had roughly double the melanoma risk of non-users, though researchers say it is too early to change prescriptions and urge further research. The finding contrasts with a 2011 mouse study suggesting Viagra might help fight melanoma."}

{"summary":"BuzzFeed rounds up 23 humorous products for misanthropes and introverts, including antisocial scarves, tees, pins, pillows, a bed tent, and prints of famous recluses. Items are sold through Amazon, Etsy, Society6 and others, ranging from about $4.99 to $129.99."}

{"summary":"AMC's \"Breaking Bad,\" which ended last year after five seasons and won the Outstanding Drama Series Emmy, has launched an awards campaign with billboards around Los Angeles. It hopes voters will honor the final eight episodes of Season 5, with the spin-off \"Better Call Saul\" possibly following."}

{"summary":"Despite recurring calls for Apple to buy Tesla whenever it struggles, the article argues the deal is unworkable because Tim Cook and Elon Musk are fundamentally different CEOs. Cook is a cautious supply-chain manager, while Musk is a visionary who needs independence to pursue his larger missions."}

{"summary":"Qantas announced a nonstop Perth-London route, about 9,008 miles and 17 hours, set to launch in March 2018 as the third-longest flight by distance. The current top three are Air India's roughly 9,400-mile route, Emirates' 8,820-mile flight and Qantas' 8,577-mile flight, and Singapore Air's planned 10,252-mile New York route could reshuffle them."}

{"summary":"Houston, fueled by its energy industry, low taxes, and job opportunities, is forecast to pass Chicago as America's third-largest city within eight to 10 years, reaching about 2.5-2.7 million people by 2025. The diverse, increasingly progressive city still faces slowed job growth from low oil prices, plus air quality and traffic problems."}

{"summary": "Netflix announced during the credits of the \"House of Cards\" Season 2 finale that \"Orange Is the New Black\" Season 2 will premiere June 6. Laura Prepon returns as Alex for at least four episodes and Lori Petty joins the cast, but plot details remain scarce."}

{"summary":"Defence Minister Manohar Parrikar has proposed all-women combat battalions in the Army, Navy and Air Force, plus women's induction via the NDA and Sainik schools, which would help overcome resistance to women commanding male troops. The opinion piece praises the idea as true empowerment, citing precedents like Netaji's Rani of Jhansi Regiment."}

{"summary":"Pokemon's CEO Tsunekazu Ishihara confirmed the franchise is coming to Nintendo's NX, saying it aims to change what a home or handheld console means, which supports rumours of a hybrid device. Nintendo has said NX will be unveiled this year and released in March 2017, though details remain speculation."}

{"summary": "A study of undergrads by researchers at UNC Chapel Hill and SUNY Buffalo found women rated men described as good storytellers more attractive as long-term partners, likely because storytelling signals higher status. Men did not rate women more attractive or higher status for storytelling ability."}

{"summary":"In this week's NBA Power Rankings, the Warriors stay No. 1 for a fourth straight week after nine consecutive wins, but the Grizzlies (NBA-best 15 wins, two losses, perfect against the West) are nearly equal. The 76ers remain a certain No. 30."}

{"summary":"European Menopause and Andropause Society guidelines urge employers to adopt workplace policies that support menopausal women, such as cooler temperatures, flexible schedules, stress reduction, and bathroom access. Researchers say few employers address menopause in occupational health policies, and managers should be trained to foster comfortable disclosure and accommodation requests."}

{"summary":"The author argues meditation is for everyone, has no right or wrong way, and can boost focus, cut stress, and prevent health ailments without any religious tie. She shares a simple one-minute morning technique learned in China in a video episode and offers a free meditation MP3."}

{"summary":"NPR visuals head Brian Boyer and a team won a $35,000 Knight Foundation grant to build Carebot, a tool that measures a story's impact through metrics like completion rate, shares per page view, and asking readers if they loved it. He hopes it will reduce clickbait incentives and reward stories that make people care."}

{"summary": "Robert Schwentke, director of \"Red\" and \"R.I.P.D.,\" will direct \"Insurgent,\" the \"Divergent\" sequel due March 20, 2015, replacing Neil Burger, who reportedly could not return because of the tight turnaround. Akiva Goldsman is writing the script from a draft by Brian Duffield."}

{"summary": "Prince George's habit of wearing shorts and knee socks follows an aristocratic British tradition dating to the 16th century, etiquette expert William Hanson says. Boys were moved from gowns into breeches or shorts, while trousers were seen as menswear, and the royal family still keeps the custom."}

{"summary": "The article argues that a leather jacket is the one wardrobe staple every man should own, citing its cool-guy history and versatility. It advises choosing a style and budget, suggests faux leather as a cheaper trial, and warns against buying a leather blazer."}

{"summary":"The article claims Bollywood actor and former supermodel Dino Morea has a lookalike in Scott Foley, who plays Jake on the American TV series Scandal. It says the resemblance is striking and that others have noticed it too, citing a tweet."}

{"summary":"Niantic's CEO says Pokémon Go will earn ad revenue through \"sponsored locations,\" where companies pay to become in-game spots that drive foot traffic to their stores. The satirical piece mocks expected user outrage and jokes that the model could also steer players to band shows or protests."}

{"summary": "The shortlist for the Sony World Photography Awards, the world's largest photography competition, has been released, with a winner to be announced on 20 April. The article showcases selected images from over 220,000 entries, spanning subjects such as Mount Fuji, pandas, bullfighting trainees, racism in India and life in Armenia."}

{"summary": "Conservative health care wonk Avik Roy tells Vox's Zack Beauchamp at the Republican convention that the GOP is doomed because, since Goldwater's 1964 stance against the Civil Rights Act, its base has been driven by white nationalism, paving the way for Trump. He says conservatives must build a new movement."}

{"summary": "A hyperpartisan post claims a school sent home a slip letting parents exempt their children from reciting the Pledge of Allegiance, and says one mother responded angrily on a Facebook page. It blames liberals and Obama, uses abusive language, and urges readers to vote for Donald Trump; its claims are unverified."}

{"summary":"Airlines can bump passengers for overbooking, safety or weight issues, crew transportation needs, or rule-breaking, as in the United incident where a passenger was forcibly removed. Federal rules require airlines to seek volunteers first, with compensation for involuntary bumping that causes long delays."}

{"summary":"Marketers often don't know whether their content is actually read. Eye-tracking research and CoSchedule's heatmaps show readers skim in an F-pattern and few reach the end, and shares don't correlate with reading. {"summary":"A flawless 100-carat, emerald-cut diamond sold for $22.1 million at Sotheby's New York \"Magnificent Jewels\" auction, within three minutes of bidding opening, the priciest colorless diamond ever auctioned in the city. An anonymous telephone bidder won it, and it fell within its $19-25 million estimate."}

{"summary": "Loughborough University researchers report that an hour in a 40-degree bath may burn about 126 calories, roughly like a 20-30 minute walk, and lower blood sugar, thanks to heat shock proteins. The article suggests baths can complement a healthy routine but not replace diet or exercise."}

{"summary": "Former congressman Tom Perriello's surprise entry into Virginia's Democratic gubernatorial primary challenges establishment pick Lt. Gov. Ralph Northam and echoes the 2016 presidential dynamics, with Republicans Ed Gillespie and Corey Stewart in a similar establishment-versus-insurgent fight. {"summary":"The article claims pasteurized cow's milk harms bone health, arguing that heating destroys beneficial bacteria, enzymes and some nutrients, hindering calcium absorption, and it points to high osteoporosis rates in high-dairy countries. {"summary":"Snickle Fritz, a huge dog found as a puppy in a roadside cardboard box, was adopted by a family who didn't expect him to grow so big. The gentle giant lives next door to the children's grandma and happily visits her often for belly scratches and kisses."}

{"summary": "Australian Samuel Leighton-Dore and his partner Bradley Tennant plan to have a child using an egg donated by Samuel's sister Bronte, fertilised with Bradley's sperm and carried by a surrogate, so both men are genetically linked to the baby. {"summary":"An anonymous source told US Weekly that Rob Kardashian and Blac Chyna are expecting a girl, due in October. The couple is reportedly thrilled and planning an extravagant nursery, though they haven't confirmed the baby's gender publicly."}

{"summary":"Country Fresh recalled about 30,000 cases of precut onions, mushrooms and peppers sold in nine Southern states after a sample tested positive for Listeria; no illnesses have been reported. Listeria occurs naturally in soil, water and manure and can persist in cold, damp food-processing plants, so the CDC advises washing produce and handling food carefully."}

{"summary":"Romania's Movile Cave, sealed off for about 5.5 million years and discovered in 1986, has a poisonous, oxygen-poor, lightless environment that hosts 48 identified species, 33 found nowhere else. Its ecosystem runs on chemosynthetic bacteria rather than sunlight, and how the animals got trapped there remains unclear."}

{"summary":"The 89th Academy Awards ended in chaos when Faye Dunaway wrongly announced \"La La Land\" as best picture instead of \"Moonlight.\" Other highlights included Viola Davis's speech, Jimmy Kimmel's jabs at Trump and Matt Damon, Iranian director Asghar Farhadi's boycott statement, and Gary from Chicago going viral."}

{"summary":"After overhearing two elderly women make disparaging remarks about Aboriginal people at a Perth cafe, Jarred Walls, an Aboriginal father, sent them a pot of tea with a note signed from the \"2 aboriginals\" at the next table. He said he chose kindness over confrontation so people might think before they speak."}

{"summary":"After Merriam-Webster tweeted that \"mad\" can mean \"angry,\" Slate editor Gabriel Roth likened the dictionary to a \"chill parent,\" and it replied, \"No one cares how you feel.\" Social media cheered, while editor Peter Sokolowski said it was good-natured banter and that definitions come from actual usage."}

{"summary":"Appearing on \"The Tonight Show With Jay Leno,\" 31-year-old Kelly Clarkson said she and husband Brandon Blackstock are trying hard to conceive, though she isn't announcing a pregnancy. {"summary":"New York artist Hanny Ahern created \"When I Think About You I Text Myself,\" an anonymous hotline where people send the texts they shouldn't send to others, and the words are returned to them after three, six, nine and 12 months. {"summary": "Salesforce's global recruiting head Ana Recio, who oversees over 8,000 hires a year, opens interviews by asking candidates for their favorite pump-up song and why. She says the icebreaker has no wrong answer but reveals personality and culture fit, and research suggests good small talk can give candidates an edge."}

{"summary":"Eurostat data compiled by Statista show nearly 80% of European children were learning a second language in primary school in 2014, while the UK only made primary-level language teaching compulsory last year, leaving British pupils behind. UK figures weren't available, though more primary schools now teach languages."}

{"summary":"After the Spurs' 67-15 season ended in the second round of the playoffs, Danny Green says he doesn't know whether 40-year-old Tim Duncan or 38-year-old Manu Ginobili will retire. Both posted career-low numbers, and David West is reportedly opting out, leaving big offseason decisions."}

{"summary": "Lenovo's Yoga Book is a 10.1-inch tablet that replaces the physical keyboard with a second touch panel, which shows a haptic-feedback keyboard and trackpad or serves as a Wacom pen pad that can digitize notes written on paper. It is under 10mm thick, with 4GB of RAM and 64GB of storage."}

{"summary": "Michigan mother Stacey Wehrman Feeley photographed her three-year-old standing on a toilet, thinking it was funny, until the girl explained she was practicing her preschool's lockdown drill. {"summary":"Yogi Adityanath, a saffron-robed Hindu priest with a history of anti-Muslim rhetoric and criminal charges, became chief minister of Uttar Pradesh. {"summary":"A lockdown at Valley Forge Military Academy near Philadelphia, also covering Eastern and Cabrini universities, was likely triggered by popping bubble wrap rather than gunfire. A student called 911 after hearing what she thought were shots, but police found no weapons or injuries and lifted the lockdown after about 90 minutes."}

{"summary": "A JAMA Internal Medicine study of over 63,000 UK adults found that \"weekend warriors\" who met exercise guidelines in just one or two sessions a week were about 30 percent less likely to die during the nine-year follow-up than inactive people. Even those exercising once or twice weekly below guidelines saw similar benefits, though self-reported data and injury risk are caveats."}

{"summary": "While surveying white-lipped peccaries on Brazil's Cerrado plateau in 2009, Wildlife Conservation Society researchers found cave drawings of armadillos, birds, reptiles and big cats, likely made by hunter-gatherers 4,000 to 10,000 years ago. The styles are surprisingly diverse, and conservationists hope to protect the sites and surrounding ecosystems."}

{"summary":"Michael Easton, fired from General Hospital as Dr. Silas Clay after his character was murdered, will return in a brand new role. He began taping February 26 with an air date of March 18; ABC acted after a fan petition drew 14,000 signatures, and details about his character remain secret."}

{"summary":"This ranking of the highest-paid golfers of all time, combining PGA Tour and European Tour earnings, is topped by Tiger Woods at $122.5 million, followed by Phil Mickelson at $94.6 million and Vijay Singh at $75.9 million. The list also covers entries like Rory McIlroy, Jim Furyk and Bubba Watson, with major wins and totals."}

{"summary": "GPS For The Soul presents a guide of soothing blue scenes, noting that the color blue instantly promotes peace and relaxation and has been shown to help reduce stress. It also invites readers to share their own personal de-stressing tips and explore other GPS Guides."}

{"summary":"Marriage therapists say couples often wait about six years before seeking help, by which point resentment or apathy may have set in.
